opening.argument: The presentation frames OneCoin as a way to earn money, presenting it as a real cryptocurrency whose limited supply and rising demand will increase its value. The speaker says, “the more we mine, the more difficult it will be harder to create the coin. This means that there will be a bigger demand rather than our reserve which will increase the value of the coin.” It then characterizes acquiring the coin before it has value as “a very profitable investment” and says, “As time goes, the more coins we keep, the better the deal.” These claims promote buying early and holding OneCoin for profitable appreciation, rather than investigating or warning about the offer.
